testCase.name: [dev] S07 Nursing Home: un-mark and re-mark In Today, and the dashboard follows each time

descriptionHtml:
Bug B25 · P1 · known

The Nursing Home dashboard counts every resident (22, should be the 19 In Today); a resident taken off In Today is still on it

Tickets: TFA-92587 AC6 ready for qa; TFA-92598 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-09/S09, TC-20/S04a, TC-20/S06

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S07 Nursing Home: un-mark and re-mark In Today, and the dashboard follows each time

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Nursing Home counts are based on the residents marked 'In Today'. Marking a resident adds them to the counts. Un-marking removes them from today's counts without deleting them from All Residents (UAT TC-09; TFA-92598 AC 4; TFA-92587 AC 6; TFA-92587 AC 2)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture. The resident is In Today and pending

When Open the Nursing Home dashboard. Go to All Residents and un-mark the resident ('In Today' → '+ Today'). Open the dashboard. Go back, re-mark the resident, and open the dashboard again

Then The resident is on the dashboard at first (Total 1 / Pending 1). After the un-mark it is still on All Residents with '+ Today' (not deleted) and is off the dashboard's today counts (Total 0). After the re-mark it is back (Total 1 / Pending 1)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92587 AC 1, AC 2 and AC 6, TFA-92598 AC 4, UAT TC-09. Checked today: checkpoints 1 and 4 mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard' and the resident. Checkpoint 2 (All Residents after the un-mark) mustContain the resident and '+ Today', which is the resident's own toggle in the AC 1 wording. …

Where it ran: dev unit U69; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-92598 in progress

After the physician takes a resident off In Today, that resident still shows on the Nursing Home dashboard and is still counted.

Evidence: allure-results/ceae9c8d…: rest tier. ledger #69 (U69, checked): after the only resident is un-marked, the NH dashboard still lists them (Total 1, not 0). Same root as U57. Dev report §4. Un-mark and re-mark on All Residents work.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-20/S04a; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S07

Nursing Home: un-mark and re-mark In Today, and the dashboard follows each time

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (in progress)

Rest tier: cited ticket(s) not ready for qa (TFA-92598 in progress); read this result with that in mind, not as a regression. Result: fail.

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92587 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): known gap. Depends only on U5 (TFA-92587 AC 6, ready for QA), not on TFA-92598: after unchecking In Today the backend has false, yet the dashboard still shows Total 1 and lists the resident (B25). The run's own result was rest; its evidence is below.

Result: Fail from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U69.verdict.json), unit U69. Agent: 35 turns, 119 s, $0.21.

Plan: unit U69 (#47, rest, ui-only) — Un-mark and re-mark In Today: the dashboard follows. Legacy seed; tier 2 (TFA-92598 in its sources). Taken off the duplicate list after review: it checks parts of TC-20 U5 that TC-09 S09 does not (after the un-mark the resident is still on All Residents with '+ Today' and snf:get still finds it; its row leaves the dashboard; snf:list count 1). Not merged with U57 (its Total 1 tiles clash with U57's five residents) or U56 (both read 'res-after'). Expected Fail (known) at s07-dash-out on the deployed build: the dashboard lists every resident (Q6, TFA-92598).

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #69, U69; checked: yes): Fail (product; rest tier — cluster D) — after un-marking the only resident the NH dashboard still lists them (Total 1, not 0) — same root as U57 (dashboard counts All Residents); expected per plan (Q6). Un-mark keeps the resident in All Residents ('+ Today'), re-mark restores
